answer: Because the ridge stake is held until the knoll settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the hollow audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 28% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer burns proportionally more than endorsing a low-cost one. A farm running 183 keys thus pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation trivial. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
